change: Bounded TextureRect layouts/flips and native GradientTexture2D handles with a closed two-stop linear gradient graph, immutable replacement, native Undo/Redo and actual resource/scene save-reopen. Not arbitrary image/texture import support.
upgrade: Explicit coordinated host/plugin upgrade: bridge 0.3.4, scene.texture/v1, maximum 24 advertised capabilities. Frame/private-file limits and independent write opt-in unchanged.
contracts: Expand modes 0..1, stretch modes 0..6 and boolean flips; fields on other controls fail without mutation
Gradient textures are 1..32 per dimension, two finite 0..1 Colors, horizontal linear sRGB, non-HDR, no repeat
Only a native script-free GradientTexture2D -> Gradient graph is admitted; reject custom metadata, opaque dependencies and oversized storage
Handles retain owner/project/session/fingerprint/TTL/quota boundaries; another owner, forged fingerprint and released handle are rejected
Resource textures cannot be edited in place through resource_set; create a replacement and approve its exact scene assignment
Memory/current-scene inline handles preserve explicit shared or unique ownership and native Undo/Redo
External exported textures require make_unique before embedding; shared external references and pre-existing external TextureRect dependencies fail closed
A live gradient change during approval invalidates the document/handle fingerprint and prevents commit
Partially invalid batches leave no created node behind; rejected cases retain original scene bytes
Native ResourceSaver export/adoption and actual scene save/reopen preserve complete gradient storage, owners, groups, signals and sharing; normalize only identities and inline path identity
Local native rendered PNG changes by over 1000 pixels after horizontal flip and returns to zero difference after restoring it
